author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete these GO terms:
- GO:0036258 multivesicular body assembly
- GO:0036257 multivesicular body organization
- GO:0070676 intralumenal vesicle formation
- GO:1905365 regulation of intralumenal vesicle formation
- GO:1905366 negative regulation of intralumenal vesicle formation
- GO:1905367 positive regulation of intralumenal vesicle formation

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31770

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MA0ztubcbSmbaMVb8VjKuBTBIhST0altv-4vdX6YY-g

Impacted groups:
ComplexPortal	89
FlyBase	3
ParkinsonsUK-UCL	33 - done
SGD	18
TAIR	6
UniProt	12
WB	1

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)
* InterPro2GO: IPR045893 (FREE1) → GO:0036258 (multivesicular body assembly). Suggest remapping to GO:0032509 (endosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway): free1 mutants lack intralumenal vesicles in MVBs and fail to deliver endocytosed plasma membrane proteins to the vacuole lumen (PMID:25438943, Fig. 2).
* No UniProt-Keyword or UniRule mappings to these terms.

Recommended replacements for each annotation are in the spreadsheet and summarized in a comment below.

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0036258 multivesicular body assembly, GO:0036257 multivesicular body organization, GO:0070676 intralumenal vesicle formation and regulation children

author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Summary of the recommendations in the review spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MA0ztubcbSmbaMVb8VjKuBTBIhST0altv-4vdX6YY-g The automated report found 159 annotations to these terms (42 experimental, 117 TAS/NAS) and 3 that use them in extensions.

**Transfer to GO:0032509 (endosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway)**
- Experimental, where the paper shows loss of intralumenal vesicles or failed MVB cargo delivery: TSG101 (fly, PMID:19571114), FREE1 (PMID:25438943), RILP (PMID:17959629; keep occurs_in GO:0005770 (late endosome)), DOA4, BRO1, VPS20 (yeast, PMID:23444383), VPS20.2, VPS24-1, VPS32.2, VPS2.1 (Arabidopsis, PMID:24812106), SNX3 (PMID:18767904).
- TAS/NAS for ESCRT subunits and complexes (ComplexPortal, ParkinsonsUK-UCL).

**Transfer to GO:1990182 (exosomal secretion)**
- ral-1 (PMID:26459596): fewer ILVs per MVB, with MVBs docking at the plasma membrane for exosome secretion. GO:0098866 (multivesicular body fusion to apical plasma membrane) is an option if the paper is judged to show the fusion step itself. (Changed from GO:0097734 (extracellular exosome biogenesis), which is to be obsoleted in geneontology/go-ontology#32713.)

**Remove as redundant: the same paper already annotates the gene to the pathway**
- Vps4a, Vps4b (PMID:21238931) → GO:0061738 (late endosomal microautophagy)
- RAB11A (PMID:15634213) and RAB27A (PMID:23092844) → GO:1990182 (exosomal secretion)
- YPT52, VPS21 (PMID:22748138) → GO:0032511 (late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway)
- lsn (PMID:19571114) and l(2)gd1 (PMID:33349255) → GO:0032509 (endosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway)
- VPS4, VPS4 complex (PMID:16505166) and SNF8 (PMID:38423010) → GO:0071985 (multivesicular body sorting pathway), which is being replaced by GO:0032509 (endosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway). The SNF8 pathway annotation is itself doubtful, since EGFR degradation was normal in that paper.

**Remove: the evidence does not support a transport pathway**
- ANY1, VPS13 (PMID:40047640), Rab5 (fly, PMID:12876219), Vps28 (fly, PMID:15728719), ALIX (Arabidopsis, PMID:26324913): MVB number or size phenotypes only.
- SNF7, DID4, VPS24, VPS20, VPS4 (yeast, PMID:19234443): in vitro reconstitution only.

**Regulation annotations and extensions**
- PRKN (PMID:26911690, IMP), now on GO:1905366 (negative regulation of intralumenal vesicle formation): redundant. The same paper already annotates PRKN to GO:1903542 (negative regulation of exosomal secretion). Parkin-deficient fibroblasts have more ILVs (Fig. 2B), normal EGFR degradation (Fig. 2C) and more exosome release (Fig. 3A), so the ILV data support the exosome route. (Changed from GO:1903552 (negative regulation of extracellular exosome assembly), whose regulated term is to be obsoleted in geneontology/go-ontology#32713.)
- RAB7A (PMID:26911690, TAS): redundant. The same paper already annotates RAB7A to GO:1903542 (negative regulation of exosomal secretion), and a Rab7 role in ILV formation is only proposed in the discussion.
- PLD3 (human), Pld3 and Pld4 (mouse) (PMID:39423811, IMP), now on GO:1905367 (positive regulation of intralumenal vesicle formation): transfer to GO:0006689 (ganglioside catabolic process), and add GO:0046474 (glycerophospholipid biosynthetic process) for BMP synthesis. Knockouts have 70–80% less BMP and accumulate gangliosides in cells (Figs. 5B–D), Pld3 knockout brain (Figs. 6C–E) and Pld4 knockout spleen (Figs. 7C–E). The reduced ILV number (Fig. 5E) is a single, secondary readout.
- Extensions: in the PLD3 extension (PMID:39423811), replace GO:1905367 (positive regulation of intralumenal vesicle formation) with GO:0046474 (glycerophospholipid biosynthetic process). In the 2 ANY1 extensions (PMID:40047640), remove GO:0036258 (multivesicular body assembly).

Supporting quotes for each recommendation are in the spreadsheet.
